post.description:
Start a session under a new id and stream it to the pause, or to the report of a request
that does not run.

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each event's data is one StreamEvent, named by `event`

post.description:
Resume a paused session with the answers and the reply, or with neither for "skip all",
and stream the reading of the reply and what it gave, the progress per agent and then the
report.

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each event's data is one StreamEvent, named by `event`

get.description: The session as it is now, so a client that lost its stream can find it again.

post.description:
The report recalculated with the complete assumptions given: no agent runs and nothing
is saved, so the report keeps its own.

get.description: Liveness check for deployment, and whether the runs are traced, for the page's notice.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description:
What is known about one decision factor. "Not sure" is a status, not a choice.

Only a stated answer, or a "not sure" read in the reply, comes from the reply; that "not sure"
keeps the phrase it was read from.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: At most 2000 characters (`maxLength`); a longer one is `reply_too_long`.

AnswersRequest.title: AnswersRequest
AnswersRequest.description:
The user's answers and their reply in their own words, which a blank one is not; no
answers and no reply is "skip all".

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: The body of every response that is not a success.

Assumptions.title: Assumptions
Assumptions.description: The values the user may change. An override never replaces the option's own lifespan.

Caveat.title: Caveat
Caveat.description: A fixed statement that follows from the scope. Its wording is applied when shown.

CheckGroup.title: CheckGroup
CheckGroup.description: The open factors under one label, each item one line.

CheckLines.title: CheckLines
CheckLines.description:
The check-before-you-buy list, report-wide; an empty group is left out, and
`confirm_price` is none when no price is to be confirmed.

ComparisonRow.title: ComparisonRow
ComparisonRow.description: One option's figures. A missing figure has its reason in `missing_reasons`.

ConfidencePart.title: ConfidencePart
ConfidencePart.description: A figure's confidence label: always its words, styled neutrally, never as a seal.

ControlPart.title: ControlPart
ControlPart.description: One of the page's controls, which only ends a line; the terminal app leaves it out.

DecisionFactor.title: DecisionFactor
DecisionFactor.description:
A researched factor's source is a web URL, the user's own factor's is the user, and the
factor of kind usage has none. Only a recurring-cost factor has a typical yearly cost, in
euro, converted at a fixed rate when its source stated USD or GBP.

DurabilityEvidence.title: DurabilityEvidence
DurabilityEvidence.description:
What supports a lifespan: one item per kind, the lifespan typical for the type, and what
testers and owners report, with the state that says why there are none.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: A run that ended without its last event once its stream had started.

EvidenceSummary.title: EvidenceSummary
EvidenceSummary.description: Counts only; turning them into a sentence is presentation.

FactorFigure.title: FactorFigure
FactorFigure.description: An option's value for one decision factor.

FactorValue.title: FactorValue
FactorValue.description: A `meets` or `fails` says what its source states; an `unverified` value has no text.

Figure.title: Figure
Figure.description: The computed figures of a comparison row, as defined in calculations.md.

FigureLine.title: FigureLine
FigureLine.description:
A "Label: value" line of the report as its two halves; the terminal app prints
"label: value". `missing` when the value says why the figure is not there.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description:
One thing a tester or an owner reported, as a summary in the app's own words; the quote
behind it is never kept (docs/adr/0005-findings-summarised-quote-logged.md). The rating is
kept as the source states it, and an owner report's rating only with its review count.

FindingsState.title: FindingsState
FindingsState.description:
Whether findings were found, looked for and none found, or not looked up
(option_evidence.md, "Findings").

FinishedSessionView.title: FinishedSessionView
FinishedSessionView.description: A saved session that holds its report, with the lines of a `report` event.

GivenAnswer.title: GivenAnswer
GivenAnswer.description: An answer the user picked: a choice, or "not sure", which has none.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: The API is up, and whether it traces its runs, so the page can say what is logged.

InterruptedSession.title: InterruptedSession
InterruptedSession.description:
A saved session that neither waits for answers nor holds a report: its run stopped
partway, on a restart or an unexpected exception, or its parsing call failed.

LcaInput.title: LcaInput
LcaInput.description:
One material of an estimate: its mass and its emission factor range in kg CO2e per kg.

The form has its own source: a page can name a material and leave its form to the model. A
separate component (electronics, a motor, a battery) keeps its mass when the masses are
scaled to the product's stated weight (docs/architecture/calculations.md).

LcaResult.title: LcaResult
LcaResult.description:
A CO2e range in kg per unit. An option with no estimate has no LCA result at all.

A model estimate (tier 3) always has inputs, a manufacturing and assembly range and the
fixed boundary; a benchmark may cover materials only.

Line.title: Line
Line.description: A finished line as parts the page lays out; the terminal app prints their text.

LinkPart.title: LinkPart
LinkPart.description: Words that link to a source, such as a site's name to the page it was read on.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: A used or refurbished item. A missing shipping cost means unknown, not free.

OptionLines.title: OptionLines
OptionLines.description:
One option's block, in the terminal's order. `shipping` and `price_seen` are there only
for a price from a web page; `savings` only for an option set against the baseline.

PausedSessionView.title: PausedSessionView
PausedSessionView.description: A saved session waiting for the user's answers, with the lines of its `session` event.

ProductOption.title: ProductOption
ProductOption.description:
A product the comparison is about. Its price comes with where and when it was seen, and
the size or variant it was quoted for when the source states one. `shipping` is the shipping
the offer states, missing when it states none. `out_of_stock` marks an option no offer has
in stock, and `incomplete` one sold without a part it needs to work (option_research.md,
"Selection").

RecalculateRequest.title: RecalculateRequest
RecalculateRequest.description:
The complete assumptions to recalculate a report with, not a change to them: the horizon,
the uses per year (none when not known) and a lifespan for any of its options.

Recalculation.title: Recalculation
Recalculation.description:
A report recalculated with other assumptions: the assumptions used, the new comparison
and evidence summary, and beside them the lines of what changed with them, the evidence
summary and the options. Nothing of it is saved.

RecurringCostState.title: RecurringCostState
RecurringCostState.description:
Whether a recurring cost was found, looked for and not found, or not looked for because
the category has no consumables (option_research.md, "Recurring cost").

ReplyReadEvent.title: ReplyReadEvent
ReplyReadEvent.description:
What the reply gave once it is read, before any agent runs: its answers that count, the
factors of the user's own it adds, whether it asked to change the request, and whether it
answered only what a choice picked or the request already answers; then its lines for the
thread.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: One shape for every outcome: declined, unclear, all skipped and no options included.

ReportLines.title: ReportLines
ReportLines.description: The lines of a report. A request that does not run has its decline only.

RunningSession.title: RunningSession
RunningSession.description: A session with a run going in this process; only the API knows.

SessionEvent.title: SessionEvent
SessionEvent.description:
The session at the pause, or with its report for a request that does not run, and its
lines.

SessionLines.title: SessionLines
SessionLines.description:
The lines of a session at the pause: what was understood, and the same words as the box's
first label, the "From your request" lines, the typical yearly costs and, by the question's
id, the source line under each question about a researched factor. A request that does not
run has its decline only.

SessionStart.title: SessionStart
SessionStart.description:
What a new session returns: the questions with the decision factors they are drawn from
and the answers the request states, or the report for a request that does not run.

SessionView.title: SessionView
SessionView.description:
A session as it is now: running, or else as it is saved. An interrupted session is
final: the page offers to start again with the text kept.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: Where a stated value came from. `stated_by` is known only for a web source that was read.

input.title: Input
input.description: At most 2000 characters (`maxLength`); a longer one is `input_too_long`.

StartRequest.title: StartRequest
StartRequest.description: The input: one text that may hold a need, a product URL and a budget.

StatedBy.title: StatedBy
StatedBy.description: Who is speaking in a web source, as the model that read it judged.

StatedIn.title: StatedIn
StatedIn.description:
Where the user's own words of an answer stand: the request, or the reply to the
questions.

StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent
StreamEvent.description:
The data of one event of a stream, named for the OpenAPI schema the frontend's types are
generated from.

TrailLine.title: TrailLine
TrailLine.description: One trail entry: `by` names the agent, its tier and its model; `line` is the rest.

TypicalLifespan.title: TypicalLifespan
TypicalLifespan.description:
The lifespan typical for a kind of product, as a range of years, with the kind its quote
names ("non-stick pans") when it names one.

UnderstoodEvent.title: UnderstoodEvent
UnderstoodEvent.description:
The request, once it is known to run, the line that shows it, and the same words as the
page's box carries them on its first label.

WarningCode.title: WarningCode
WarningCode.description: The closed set of warning codes; the table is in docs/architecture/agents.md.

WarningLine.title: WarningLine
WarningLine.description: A warning's message as one text part, with its code and the option it is about.

WarrantyTerm.title: WarrantyTerm
WarrantyTerm.description:
A warranty of a number of years, or for a lifetime; `limited` when its quote says so, as a
"limited lifetime warranty" that excludes wear does.
